verdict.rationale: Ardent documents instant branches cloned from the connected production Postgres source. Nothing in the evidence shows branching or restoring to a chosen past timestamp, a retention window, or recovering production from bad writes. Branching the current state is an adjacent capability, not point-in-time recovery, and community notes on slow backup/restore are questions rather than evidence of the feature.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restore or branch the database to any point in time within the retention window to recover from bad writes
